laws.rule: Navagio (Shipwreck) Beach, Zakynthos: a Joint Ministerial Decision in the Government Gazette bars entry to the beach and its access zone, boats coming within 50 metres of the shore, and swimming anywhere in the cove for the 2026 season, reported as running to 31 October 2026. Visitors may look from a cliff-edge platform once protective fencing is in place. The Municipality of Zakynthos enforces it and the Hellenic Police can impose administrative penalties. Emergency access is allowed. The decree text itself was not read; this follows a news report of 3 June 2026, so check the Gazette and the Zakynthos port authority for the current position.
laws.penalty_signal: administrative penalties by the Hellenic Police; amounts not stated

sources.title: Greece bans access to Navagio shipwreck beach (3 June 2026)
sources.authority: iefimerida (news report of a Joint Ministerial Decision)
